reply_text:
I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-team message. I couldn't confirm the 23 May deadline. The knowledge brain and the shared account files have nothing at all on Thornbury Cloth Co.: no contract, order form or account notes. So there was nothing to check the date against.

I also pointed out that 23 May 2026 has already passed. They may mean May 2027, or the person on the call may have misspoken. I suggested that whoever owns the account confirm the deadline with Thornbury directly, ideally in writing. I didn't save the date in the brain as a fact, since it's only an overheard claim.
